inspection_notice.label: 🚨 Routine Inspection Notice
inspection_notice.body:
🚨🚨🚨🚨 ROUTINE INSPECTION 🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨

Hi everyone 😊

I have an important update about our home. We have a routine house inspection scheduled on {{day}} {{date}}, between {{start_time}} and {{end_time}} 🏠

Here's what we need to do:

1. Personal Belongings: Please hide all personal items from the top of surfaces 📦 Put everything in bags and inside your wardrobes. Shoes can go under the bed or in plastic bags. If you use Uber bags, please place them inside or on top of your wardrobe, preferably out of visible sight. Photos will be taken, so no personal items should be visible.


2. Cleaning: The house must be absolutely clean 🧽🧹 Please clean both showers properly, remove any mould, and vacuum and mop downstairs.


3. Vacate the House: Everyone must be out of the house during the inspection time 🚶‍♂️🚶‍♀️ Please make arrangements to be elsewhere from {{start_time}} to {{end_time}} on {{day}}.


4. Rooms: Some rooms may be temporarily deactivated for the inspection but will be returned to their original setup afterwards.


Please let me know of any issues or problems in the house so I can raise them during the inspection and help get them fixed faster 🔧


If you have any questions, feel free to ask. Your cooperation is really appreciated 👍

inspection_done.label: ✅ Inspection Finished
inspection_done.body:
Thanks everyone 😊

🚨 INSPECTION FINISHED 🚨

All good guys, inspection has been finished and it's all good 👍 
Thank you all for your cooperation and patience. Do your best to keep the house clean like the way we left please.

You may come back at anytime. 

Have a great rest of the week!

Cheers

vacate_checklist.label: 📋 Pre-Vacate Checklist (3 days before)
vacate_checklist.body:
Hi 👋 just a quick checklist before vacating, so there are no issues with the Security Contribution refund, which takes about a week to be refunded.

Please make sure all of the below are done before you leave:

✅ Room

Room left clean and empty

No damage beyond fair wear and tear

Floor vacuumed, surfaces wiped

All personal belongings removed

✅ Fridge

Your used fridge space completely emptied

Shelves and drawers wiped clean

No food, spills, stains or odours

✅ Kitchen

All kitchen areas you used cleaned

Benches, cupboards, shelves and any storage you used left clean

No personal items left behind

✅ Bathroom / Ensuite (if used)

Shower, toilet, basin and mirrors cleaned

No hair, residue, mould or build-up

✅ General

Mandatory bond cleaning fee paid

All keys, fobs and access devices returned

No outstanding fees or charges

If everything above is met, the Security Contribution will be refunded without any issues, as per pages 20-24 of the house rules, including the mandatory bond cleaning fee.
If cleaning or damage is identified, the cost will need to be deducted before refund, as per the licence.

Thank you 🙏

occupancy_licence_bond_explainer.label: 📋 Occupancy Licence — Bond / Security Contribution Explainer
occupancy_licence_bond_explainer.body:
Hey {{name}} 👋 Great question, happy to explain.

You're right that a traditional "bond" under a standard rental lease gets lodged with the Residential Tenancies Authority (RTA). But our arrangement works differently — and that's intentional.

You don't have a lease. You have an Occupancy Licence.

An Occupancy Licence is a separate legal agreement that gives you the right to occupy a room in a shared house. It's not a residential tenancy agreement, so the Residential Tenancies Act and the RTA bond lodgement system don't apply to it.

What we call "bond" in the contract is technically a Security Contribution — it's a refundable deposit held under the terms of your Occupancy Licence, not lodged with the RTA. This is completely legal and standard for co-living and share house arrangements in QLD.

The key differences:
• Lease → governed by the RTA → bond lodged with RTA
• Occupancy Licence → governed by the licence contract → Security Contribution held by the manager

Your Security Contribution is fully refundable at the end of your stay, minus any deductions for damage or outstanding fees as outlined in your licence (pages 20–24 of your house rules).

Hope that clears it up — let me know if you have any other questions! 🙏
